unique.description: True if the index is a unique index.

filter.description:
Filter expression for creating partial indexes. Filter expressions must evaluate to a value type of
Boolean.  They support basic comparison operators (e.g. "==", "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "!="), arithmetic operators
(e.g. "+", "-", "*", "/"), "&&", "||" and "most" non-timeseries functions supported by the C3 expression engine.

clustersCount.description:
This parameter specifies the number of clusters to divide the vector space into. It affects the granularity of the
clustering and the trade-off between search accuracy and efficiency. Higher values of clustersCount generally lead
to better accuracy but may also increase index size and search time.

title:
The Inverted File Index Flat (IVF_FLAT) index method is the simplest IVF index method. It stores the original vectors in each
cluster, without any quantization. This makes it the most accurate IVF index, but it also makes it the least memory
efficient. Represents B-tree indexing storage options.
name: Db.Index.IvfFlat
